column1: # Method batch: ui.VectorTextRenderer, ui.hud.TutorialHintBox and the confident part of
#  * VectorTextRenderer - read straight off the bodies: a(int) caches a packed colour into the two
#    short halves r/s; a(int,int) builds the 2D orthographic matrix (2/w, -2/h) and uploads it to
#    u_mvpMatrix; a() calls ShaderProgram.a() (bind); the draw family ends in a(int,int,int,int,int)
#    which pushes ONE line segment into the vertex/index buffers; a(float,float,float,float,int)
#    fills that rectangle row by row, so it is a filled rect; c() disposes every GlBuffer and then
#  * TutorialHintBox   - a(II) sets width/height then re-anchors; a() and the "Next" button share the
#    same condition (scriptStep.c() == null) at L135, so a() means "this step waits for a click";
#    b(II)/c() show and hide the arrow Image g (whose y is animated in draw()); the private d()
#    re-reads the current step into the label and re-measures the box; m() parses the "L|C:R" and
#  * GuiAssets         - fonts are named from the font file each getter returns
#    a(Faction) indexes the 10-entry TextureRegion[] r by faction id (flags);
#    D() is called at the top of button listeners (RestartConfirmListener L22, QuitConfirmListener,
#    PlayerSlotListener, PauseMenuListener) and its body is AudioClip.a() -> play the click sound.
# Rows left BLANK on purpose (keep the trailing tab, they stay 5-column):
#  * TutorialHintBox.b() - returns ScriptStep.d(), the 4th field of a tutorial row; its meaning is
#    not established by any call site yet.
#  * GuiAssets styles/nine-patches (i..C, j, k, l..q, r..C) - each is only a set of texture
#    coordinates; the honest name comes from WHERE it is used, which needs a per-caller pass.
# Descriptors come from javap: do not edit them, the renamer matches on them.
# Columns: owner <TAB> kind <TAB> old <TAB> descriptor <TAB> new
